The Catalyst-CA gating (charge only queueable after an attack) is a per-character input constraint that the permissive notation model doesn't enforce, and combo-counter persistence across dash/E is a description-level continuity detail — in the planner the user explicitly notates the combo they intend, so neither produces a visible timeline divergence a knowledgeable player would be misled by.

verdicts.rationale: Prosecution Edict grants a real, decision-relevant self ATK buff (6% per stack, max 5 = up to +30% ATK) while in the Chilling Penalty state, and the passive has no authored effect at all, so this buff is entirely absent from Wriothesley's buff rows — a knowledgeable player scanning the timeline would wrongly read it as having no stance ATK buff. It is not implementable: stacks accrue on HP increases/decreases (onPlayerHit/onHeal), which are on the CANNOT list of unconsumed triggers. A gainStacks-onHit proxy was rejected because it changes the trigger semantics, drops the heal-driven stacks, and has no stance-scoped stack lifetime. 'Not modeled' (not manual-trigger phrasing) is correct because no effect is authored.
verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the Prosecution Edict ATK buff (up to +30% ATK) gained on HP changes while in the Chilling Penalty state.

groundedIn.claim: Prosecution Edict adds 6% ATK per stack, max 5 stacks (up to +30% ATK), gained on HP change while in the Chilling Penalty state
groundedIn.quote: When Wriothesley's current HP increases or decreases, if he is in the Chilling Penalty state conferred by Icefang Rush, Chilling Penalty will gain one stack of Prosecution Edict. Max 5 stacks. Each stack will increase Wriothesley's ATK by 6%.

groundedIn.claim: The buff is not authored because its HP-change / heal triggers are null-resolving in the planner; probable value is 6% x stacks, max 5 = 30%
groundedIn.quote: Intentionally not authored per stub-with-caveat philosophy 2026-05-14 (onPlayerHit + onHeal categories — both HP-change subscriptions are null-resolving in the planner; HP state isn't simulated). Probable shape if a primitive ever lands: type:'buff', target:'self', stat:'atk%', value: scaling on stack count (6% × stacks, max 5 stacks = 30%)…
